scope: One source-checked HERCULAN Engine reimplementation discovered from a Reddit discussion; game files and media remain remote references only.

projects.title: Earthsiege 2 — HERCULAN Engine
projects.platform: Windows 10+ and Linux x86-64 (glibc 2.34+), OpenGL 3.3; requires original Earthsiege 2 files
projects.status: Beta. Release v0.9.8 was published 2026-10-16. The maintainer says it supports the full retail v1.0, Hi-Rez 1.0, and 1.10 GoldGames versions; the engine supports Windows and Linux. Original game files are required and are not included.
projects.summary: A reverse-engineered, modern reimplementation of Dynamix’s 1996 mech simulation Earthsiege 2. It supports widescreen and ultrawide displays, hardware-accelerated OpenGL rendering, retail file formats and saves, and installation from a retail CD or ISO. The repository also contains HercWorks CSharp, a related Windows-only tool suite that is not a separate catalog project.
projects.language: English, French, and German (documented retail game versions)
projects.source_available: Public source repository under MIT; HERCULAN branding assets are excluded from that license. Requires the user’s own original game files; no game data is distributed.
projects.subtype: 1996 Windows game engine reimplementation; Linux and modern Windows support
